verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own import/export docs list many portable import formats (Insomnia JSON v4/YAML v5, Postman v2.0/v2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, cURL). Import works via UI from File, Clipboard or URL, so moving collections in from other tools is well covered. Export, the other half of the story, is only implied by the page title and has no explicit format list. missing for 10: explicit documentation of export formats and destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration of round-trip portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import and export collections in portable formats to move between tools
